name: DigitalOcean Server
description: Host Recursive on a DigitalOcean Droplet that joins your Tailscale network. Nothing on it is open to the internet.

provider.label: DigitalOcean
provider.description: An always-on Droplet from about $12 a month, private to your tailnet.

schema.label: DigitalOcean API token
schema.description: A personal access token with read and write scope (API → Tokens).

schema.label: Tailscale auth key
schema.description: A reusable or one-off key from the Tailscale admin console (Settings → Keys). The server joins your tailnet with it; this computer must be on the same tailnet.
